verdict.rationale: Highnote's docs homepage advertises an "interactive code explorer" alongside its GraphQL API, which points to a first-party interactive API exploration surface. That is a single marketing mention with no detail on how the explorer works or whether its examples run against the test environment. The OpenAPI probe 404s are not a contradiction, since the API is GraphQL. Missing for 10: documentation of the interactive reference itself, explicit runnable examples (e.g. executing queries against the sandbox from the docs), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Build faster with GraphQL API, interactive code explorer, PCI-compliant SDKs, and real-time web hooks designed for modern development.
